quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS Unveils Enterprise Agentic AI Solution and Full-Stack (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASUS unveiled its Enterprise Agentic AI Solution, an integrated full-stack offering of three layers: ASUS AI HUB (fleet-wide agent registration, governance and monitoring), NVIDIA AI Enterprise with the ASUS AI Software Stack, and ASUS AI servers and infrastructure such as its full-stack AI factory platform powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 (which ASUS says is co-designed to deliver 30X-higher throughput per megawatt and 45X-lower token cost for agentic AI), aimed at finance, healthcare, manufacturing, the public sector and other regulated industries. Also shown: the XA P8A-E14AXL 6U server with eight liquid-cooled NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, the ESC8000-E12P (RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell) and ESC8000A-E13X (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with ConnectX-8 SuperNICs), and the PE3000N edge system on the NVIDIA Jetson T5000 module (up to 2,070 FP4 TFLOPS and 128GB of memory).
quarterly_data.figure: 30X-higher throughput per megawatt; 45X-lower token cost; up to 2,070 FP4 TFLOPS
